Kisan Nanaware (28), who held a dharna demanding bride at the District Collector’s office in September, now plans to build a network of unmarried rural youth to protest against State apathy to their plight. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
It is not the inflation, unemployment, deletion of names from the voters’ list or corruption that is simmering in rural Maharashtra youth who are gearing up for an agitation. Unlike other Gen Z across India , these youth have an unusual demand – get us brides to marry.
“We are planning not only a Statewide but a nationwide network of boys who are not getting brides to marry and plan a massive agitation,” Kisan Nanaware, a 28-year-old youth from Solapur, told The Hindu .
